external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Central MN Conservation Partnership is a collaborative effort led by Centra Sota Cooperative to help farmers improve groundwater quality through practical conservation practices. Working alongside the Minnesota Department of Agriculture and local conservation partners, the program provides technical assistance, education, and funding support to promote irrigation water management, efficient nitrogen use, and long-term farm sustainability in Central Minnesota.

At Centra Sota, we work with a variety of producers and know that a manure management strategy may not be one-size-fits-all. We’re pleased to share two podcasts featuring Centra Sota’s Lead Environmental Specialist, Amy Robak, as she joins Dana Adams – U of MN Extension Educator, Livestock – and Miranda Wagner, Sherburne SWCD to discuss manure management strategies for large operations and small.
